full_judgment: 3. Respondent Nos. 1-12 herein filed Title Suit No. 71 of 1989 for declaration of their title in the suit land and also for partition after evicting the "defendants from the suit land. Their case, in short is that C S Khatian Nos. 1030 and 625 were recorded in the names of Shadhu Mondal and Sekander Mondal in equal shares and Sekander Mondal died leaving behind his brother. Shadhu Mondal and two Sisters, namely, Kheri Bibi and Bheri Bibi The two sisters possessed the suit land in their 2 annas share each by paying rents and after the death of their husbands, both Kheir Bibi and Bheri Bibi came back to their paternal house at Court Chandpur and used to live with Shadhu Mondal along with their Children after the death of Kheri Bibi and Bheri Bibi, the plaintiffs being their heirs used to possess the suit land on paying rents. The plaintiffs possessed the northern part of Plot Nos. 45/48 and southern part of Plot Nos. 637, 638 and 1586 by plucking fruits and cutting and selling bamboos grown thereon but on 8th 13hadra, 1394 B.S. the defendants dispossessed the plaintiffs from the suit land. Hence the plaintiffs were constrained to file title suit for declaration of their title in the suit land and also for partition after evicting the defendants from the suit land.
